verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state 'Create your first agent with a single command and start building,' indicating an official CLI/scaffolding command for new agent projects, and the framework's MCP docs server integrates with coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) for AI-native workflows.
